newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa to outlaw corporal punishment.
newsitem.headline: South Africa to outlaw corporal punishment.

text.p: The South African government on Wednesday introduced draft legislation to outlaw whipping as a criminal sentence.
The Department of Correctional Services said in a memorandum supporting the bill that it was in line with the new constitution guaranteeing human dignity and outlawing torture.
The government outlawed corporal punishment in schools soon after President Nelson Mandela's African National Congress won the first democratic elections in April 1994.
